name: sxir
description: SyntaxIR grammar files: syntax highlighting, and diagnostics, formatting, navigation, hover, rename and completion from the sxir language server

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, the workspace cannot choose the command that runs the language server (sxir.server.path).

sxir.server.enabled.description: Start the SyntaxIR language server (sxir lsp) for .sxir files. Syntax highlighting works without it.

sxir.server.path.description: The sxir command that runs the language server: a name looked up on the PATH, or an absolute path. In an untrusted workspace, the workspace's value is ignored.

sxir.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server in the SyntaxIR Language Server output channel.

sxir.server.experimentalLint.description: Enable experimental lint diagnostics, guarded explanations, version-checked quick fixes (suppression, merging overlapping character-class ranges, removing a lookahead that always succeeds, and deleting an unused rule) and responsive analysis. Restart the language server when this setting changes.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-grammar.js && node scripts/check-extension.js && node scripts/check-lint-actions.js && node --unhandled-rejections=strict scripts/check-client.js
